name: Ruy Lopez
description: Pressure the knight that defends e5 with 3.Bb5, then build a classic centre with c3 and d4.

lines.name: Closed (5…Be7)

notes.4: Bb5 attacks the knight that defends e5, a long-term pressure.
notes.6: Ba4 keeps the bishop aimed at the c6 knight.
notes.12: Bb3 retreats to a great diagonal aiming at f7.
notes.14: c3 prepares d4 and gives the bishop a retreat to c2.

lines.summary: Bb5, Ba4, O-O, Re1, Bb3 and c3: the classic slow build-up before d4.

lines.name: Chigorin (9…Na5)

notes.4: Bb5 attacks the knight that defends e5, a long-term pressure.
notes.6: Ba4 keeps the bishop aimed at the c6 knight.
notes.12: Bb3 retreats to a great diagonal aiming at f7.
notes.14: c3 prepares d4 and gives the bishop a retreat to c2.
notes.16: h3 stops …Bg4, which would pin the knight that supports d4.
notes.18: Bc2 keeps the bishop on its diagonal towards Black's king.
notes.20: d4 finally builds the big centre that the whole set-up was preparing.
notes.22: Nbd2 starts the Nf1-g3 knight tour.

lines.summary: h3, Bc2 and d4, then Nbd2-f1-g3: the classical Ruy Lopez plan.

lines.name: Anti-Marshall (8.h3)

notes.4: Bb5 attacks the knight that defends e5, a long-term pressure.
notes.6: Ba4 keeps the bishop aimed at the c6 knight.
notes.12: Bb3 retreats to a great diagonal aiming at f7.
notes.13: …O-O prepares the Marshall Attack, a famous pawn sacrifice after 8.c3 d5.
notes.14: h3 avoids the Marshall; after …d6, c3 brings us back to the main line.

lines.summary: When Black castles before …d6, play h3 to dodge the Marshall Attack.

lines.name: Anti-Marshall into the Chigorin

notes.4: Bb5 attacks the knight that defends e5, a long-term pressure.
notes.6: Ba4 keeps the bishop aimed at the c6 knight.
notes.12: Bb3 retreats to a great diagonal aiming at f7.
notes.13: …O-O prepares the Marshall Attack, a famous pawn sacrifice after 8.c3 d5.
notes.14: h3 avoids the Marshall; after …d6, c3 brings us back to the main line.
notes.16: c3: this is now the Closed Ruy Lopez main line.
notes.20: d4 builds the centre, just as in the Chigorin.

lines.summary: The Anti-Marshall order joins the main line: same plan, same position.

lines.name: Open (5…Nxe4)

notes.4: Bb5 attacks the knight that defends e5, a long-term pressure.
notes.6: Ba4 keeps the bishop aimed at the c6 knight.
notes.10: d4 opens the centre while the black king is still uncastled.
notes.14: dxe5 wins back the pawn and gains space.
notes.16: c3 gives the bishop a retreat to c2 and keeps the e5 pawn strong.

lines.summary: Let Black take e4, then open the centre with d4 and win the pawn back on e5.

lines.name: Moller / Arkhangelsk (6…Bc5)

notes.4: Bb5 attacks the knight that defends e5, a long-term pressure.
notes.6: Ba4 keeps the bishop aimed at the c6 knight.
notes.12: c3 prepares d4 to kick the active c5 bishop.
notes.14: d4 hits e5 and the bishop; White gains space in the centre.

lines.summary: When the bishop goes to c5, play c3 and d4 to push it back.

lines.name: 4.d3

notes.4: Bb5 attacks the knight that defends e5, a long-term pressure.
notes.6: d3 defends e4 and avoids the drawish Berlin endgame.
notes.8: c3 gives the bishop a retreat and prepares d4.

lines.summary: Against the Berlin, keep it simple with d3 and c3, like an Italian with the bishop on b5.

lines.name: Steinitz (3…d6)

notes.4: Bb5 attacks the knight that defends e5, a long-term pressure.
notes.6: d4 attacks e5 at once; Black's set-up is passive.
notes.8: Nc3 develops and adds support to e4.
notes.12: Re1 defends e4 and keeps the pressure on e5.

lines.summary: Against 3…d6, push d4 at once and develop; Black is cramped.

lines.name: Classical (3…Bc5)

notes.4: Bb5 attacks the knight that defends e5, a long-term pressure.
notes.6: c3 prepares d4, which hits the c5 bishop with tempo.
notes.10: d4 claims the centre and pushes the bishop back.
notes.12: Bg5 pins the f6 knight, adding pressure on e5.

lines.summary: Against …Bc5, c3 and d4 take the centre with tempo, then pin with Bg5.
